# Jeans for Joy

> Jeans for Joy is a fundraising and advocacy campaign by Single Mothers Safe Haven Trust (SMSH) in Gaborone, Botswana, running October 2026 to February 2027. Three events raise money for equipment, training and start-up packs for single mothers in catering, agro-processing and tailoring. Concept, strategy and site by Swift Social Connect (Pty) Ltd.

Site: https://jeansforjoy.com/
Trust registration: TUHGB-000021-24

## Events

### Mama's Table
- Date: Saturday 31 October 2026, 18:00 to 22:00
- Venue: Treehaus The Meeting Place, Block 5, Gaborone
- What it is: a semi-private dinner and networking evening for single mothers running early-to-growth-stage businesses. Speakers, breakout corners and a mini-pitch stage. Dress code: jeans.
- Access: by application. Applying is free.
- Prices: single seat P450 · double (two seats) P800 · VIP seat P800 · sponsor a mother's seat P450

### Denim & Culture Workshop
- Date: Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November 2026, 10:00 to 16:00
- Venue: Val Interiors, Setlhoa Park Block 10, Gaborone
- What it is: a hands-on denim upcycling and embroidery session led by SMSH skills trainers. Bring one old pair of jeans. Beginners welcome.
- Capacity: 60 seats
- Prices: seat with all supplies P350 · under-16 seat P300 · school or group seat (5+) P350

### The Denim Parade + Jeans & Gems Market (flagship)
- Date: Saturday 27 February 2027, 10:00 to 16:00
- Venue: to be announced, Gaborone
- What it is: the Jeans & Gems fashion market in the morning (local designers, instant-design corner, food, kids' corner), then a blue-carpet denim parade judged live in three categories (Best Team Look, Most Creative Individual, Most Cultural Expression), with prizes and a closing ceremony.
- Entry: kids under 10 P50 (under-5s free) · individual P100 · small organisation or business team of 3 P300 · corporate team of 4 P600
- Stalls: vendor stall P350 · food stall P400

## Booking and policies
- Book through the form on the site, or WhatsApp +267 74 310 425.
- Refunds up to 3 days before an event; after that the payment becomes a donation.
- Tickets are transferable up to 48 hours before an event.

## Payments and donations
- Bank transfer: Single Mother Safe Haven, Bank Gaborone, account 2000639857, SWIFT BGLIBWGX
- Orange Money: +267 75 010 920
- From outside Botswana: Remitly to the Orange Money number
- Send proof of payment on WhatsApp to confirm.

## Where the money goes
- 70% equipment and start-up packs
- 20% training and trainer fees
- 10% event production and admin

## Who SMSH serves
- Mothers raising children with disabilities
- Teen mothers
- Mothers in challenging situations (separation, custody, abuse or threats)
- Mothers facing mental health challenges
- Talented mothers who need a scholarship or start-up capital

## Sponsors and partners
Sponsors give cash or product in exchange for visibility across the campaign, including naming rights on an award, category or activation zone. Partners contribute venues, media, schools, mentors or services. Enquiries: hello@swiftsocialconnect.com
